subject: Subscription retention status and forecast check-in
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Subscription retention status and forecast check-in

Team —

Attached is the Q2 snapshot exported from HubSpot. I pulled accounts with renewals in May–June and flagged those with >20% ARR at risk based on usage and support escalations. Quick asks:

- Please update stage and commit probability for any account you own by EOD Tuesday (2027-04-27). Use the "forecast lock" column if you want Finance to include/exclude from the committed ARR.
- If an account is at-risk, add a 2–3 line note in the comment field with the primary reason (product, budget, exec churn) and suggested mitigation.
- Marissa: I flagged Nimbus Analytics as high risk — can you confirm next steps and whether CS has an open playbook?

I'll consolidate updates for the April 30 forecast call. If there are material downgrades, we need to surface them to FinOps and GTM leads before the call.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q2_renewal_snapshot.csv (spreadsheet with stage/probability/ARR columns)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-26T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subscription retention status and forecast check-in

Diego —

Thanks for the snapshot. I updated the sheet with my book: 8 accounts moved stages, three downgrades to "At Risk". Key notes (summary):

- Nimbus Analytics — Prob down to 35% (usage down ~40% last 90 days, primary contact Sarah Li out until June). We have an open support case (#SR-7842) for integration latency; CS suggests a technical deep-dive and a 10% one-time credit as a retention lever. See attached risk memo.
- Osprey Labs — Customer asked for a 6-month deferral; commercial prefers negotiating term rather than immediate churn.
- Beacon Health — payment delay, legal review of contract amendment. FinOps flagged with Naomi.

I've attached a short risk PDF with the Nimbus timeline and recommended outreach cadence. I'll try to schedule a call with their CTO this week.

Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Midmarket
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Nimbus_Risk_Details.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-27T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subscription retention status and forecast check-in

Good notes — quick thoughts:

- For Nimbus, propose a short-term credit + SRE hours package (2 weeks) tied to a statement of work; we can make a conditional concession in exchange for a 12-month renewal commitment. If they sign, treat as partial commit (60%).
- I'll reach out to their CFO and loop CS on a technical timing plan.
- Naomi: please model the 60% partial commit as "contingent" in the forecast and show both committed and contingent ARR for the call.

If anyone else has alternative containment plays, drop them here.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Alice Chen <alice@NimbusAnalytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-28T13:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subscription retention status and forecast check-in

Aditya / Marissa —

Appreciate the outreach. To be transparent, Nimbus is evaluating two alternatives: your proposal and a vendor with a lower quoted TCO. The latency issue has degraded a key dashboard for our product team, which is why execs are nervous. A technical deep-dive and a short-term remediation plan would help; finance is also sensitive to credits but will consider a path that reduces risk of recurrence.

Can we set a 30-minute call Friday (2027-04-30) PST to review the remediation plan and outline a commercial path? Our CFO (Alan Park) will be on the call.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Head of Product Operations
Nimbus Analytics

Cc: FinOps <finops@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-30T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Subscription retention status and forecast check-in

Team —

Good progress and appreciate the quick replies. Action items for the April 30 forecast publish (tomorrow):

1) Marissa: lock Nimbus as "contingent" at 60% and add the call cadence and SOW outline to the risk memo.
2) Naomi: include both committed and contingent ARR in the top-line slide; annotate material downside scenarios (>=20% ARR movement).
3) Aditya: confirm call with Nimbus (Friday) and try to get Alan Park on. Please capture any verbal commitments as an update to the CRM and flag deal stage movement.

Finance will publish the revised committed forecast at 10:00 PT on 2027-05-01. If we see additional downgrades overnight, notify me immediately so we can consider a provisional reserve.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
